product_one_liner.value: iVoyant provides enterprise digital-transformation services—including AI and data analytics, cloud, integrations, and application development—to businesses seeking to modernize operations and software.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes itself as a technology solutions and services provider, rather than presenting a single standalone product as its sole offering.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer and contact page provide no pricing page or public plan prices; the contact page is a general inquiry form.

named_customers.notes: The company has a case-studies page, but the reviewed examples describe clients generically and do not disclose customer names.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees. Its displayed employee count differs from some third-party estimates, so this uses LinkedIn's stated company-size band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn marks Atlanta, Georgia as headquarters; the company About page gives an Atlanta address.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is predominantly general business/technology thought leadership and marketing content. Although some posts discuss technical subjects, the reviewed index and sample did not establish at least two qualifying posts about how the product is built by engineers.

public_docs.notes: The public homepage navigation and footer show no product documentation, help center, or developer-portal link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists UX/UI Designer Internship and Azure Platform Engineer – DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure; neither title is an AI/ML or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the product page, public blog material, and privacy/legal information; iVoyant does not publicly identify a model provider used by its product. A blog example of a personal project using Google Gemini is not a statement about iVoyant's product.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed legal/privacy page does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as company certifications. The company has separately published about ISO 9001, which is outside the requested list.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn describes iVoyant as unfunded and reports no funding rounds; therefore there is no round date or amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile reports no rounds, so there is no outside funding in the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers page lists UX/UI Designer Internship and Azure Platform Engineer – DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure, with no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog index and product page did not show a dated product or major-feature launch in the window May 9–November 9, 2026. The visible 2026 announcement is company recognition, not a product launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small leadership/team listing names its leaders but gives no evidence that a C-level or VP-level person joined or left in the period; no departure or appointment was identified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Koodisi product page lists Salesforce and HubSpot among its pre-built connectors. This is a product integration signal, not evidence that iVoyant internally uses these systems.
